description: This file defines types, constants, and interfaces for implementing the SPDY protocol (version 3), including frame structures, control flags, error codes, and a Framer for serializing/deserializing frames.

classes.name: ControlFrameHeader
classes.description: Represents the header of a control frame, including version, frame type, flags, and length.

classes.name: SynStreamFrame
classes.description: Represents a SYN_STREAM frame with stream ID, associated stream ID, priority, slot, and headers.

classes.name: SynReplyFrame
classes.description: Represents a SYN_REPLY frame with stream ID and headers.

classes.name: RstStreamFrame
classes.description: Represents a RST_STREAM frame with stream ID and status.

classes.name: SettingsFlagIdValue
classes.description: Represents a combined flag, ID, and value for a SETTINGS frame.

classes.name: SettingsFrame
classes.description: Represents a SETTINGS frame with header and list of flag/id/value pairs.

classes.name: PingFrame
classes.description: Represents a PING frame with a unique ID.

classes.name: GoAwayFrame
classes.description: Represents a GOAWAY frame with last good stream ID and status.

classes.name: HeadersFrame
classes.description: Represents a HEADERS frame with stream ID and headers.

classes.name: WindowUpdateFrame
classes.description: Represents a WINDOW_UPDATE frame with stream ID and delta window size.

classes.name: DataFrame
classes.description: Represents a DATA frame with stream ID, flags, and payload data.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: Represents an error with code and associated stream ID.

classes.name: Framer
classes.description: Handles serializing and deserializing SPDY frames, including compression and decompression.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the error code.

methods.name: NewFramer
methods.description: Creates a new Framer instance for a SPDY connection with given reader and writer.
